name: Polar Clash
shortDescription: Turn-based magnet duel: drop beads, dodge chain snaps, empty your hand first.
description: A turn-based magnet board duel. Place one bead per turn on the warm cork board - but any bead landing inside another bead's magnetic field snaps and pulls the whole connected group back into your hand. Play solo against up to three AI opponents or take the solo survival challenge, across three visual themes.
